en: In the name of Allah, The Profoundly Merciful, The Continually Merciful.

ar: رَبِّ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِيْنِۙ ۝۹۷ وَ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَّحْضُرُوْنِ ۝۹۸
tr: Rabbi a`ūdhu bi ka min hamazāti ‘sh-Shayātīni, Wa a`ūdhu bi ka Rabbi a ‘yyaḥḍurūn.
en: My Lord, I seek refuge with You from the temptations of devils, I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they appear!

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ ـ ثلاثا
tr: Allāhumma innī a`ūdhu bi ka min ‘l-hammi wa ‘l-ḥazani, Wa a`ūdhu bi ka min ‘l-`ajzi wa ‘l-kasali, Wa a`ūdhu bi ka min ‘l-jubni wa ‘l-bukhli, Wa a`ūdhu bi ka min ghalabati ‘d-dayni wa qahri ‘r-rijāl.
en: O Allah, I surely seek refuge with You from sorrow and sadness. I seek refuge with You from incapacity and laziness. I seek refuge with You from cowardice and stinginess. I seek refuge with You from hopelessness of debt and subjugation by men. [3 times]

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْعَيْلَةِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ بَلِيَّةٍ.
tr: Allāhumma innī a`ūdhu bi ka mina ‘l-faqri wa ‘l-`aylati, Wa a`ūdhu bi ka min kulli baliyyattin.
en: O Allah, I surely seek refuge with You from need and poverty. I seek refuge with You from every tribulation.
